issues.where: sunlit left and upper-left limb of Mars (crops B, D, H; also pair-01-b.png left limb)
issues.what: the sunlit planet disc terminates in a hard, stair-stepped circular cutout edge against the outer halo instead of blending through the soft pale cyan-blue inner atmospheric layer seen in -a
issues.fix: anti-alias and feather the sunlit sphere edge and composite the inner cyan-blue atmospheric scattering bloom across the limb boundary so the surface blends smoothly into the outer glow

issues.where: upper-right limb of Mars (crop C; also pair-01-b.png upper-right limb)
issues.what: the cyan-blue atmospheric rim glow fades out near the top of crop C and is missing along most of the upper-right limb, exposing a raw stair-stepped sphere silhouette against space plus a small stray blue smudge off the limb
issues.fix: extend and soften the cyan-blue atmospheric rim glow continuously down the upper-right limb to match -a, anti-alias the dark limb silhouette, and remove the stray blue dot outside the limb

issues.where: Phobos upper-left sunlit rim (crop G; also pair-01-b.png)
issues.what: a thin double-contour matte seam and slight pixel stair-stepping appear along Phobos's upper-left sunlit edge against Mars
issues.fix: tighten and anti-alias the Phobos cutout/mesh edge to eliminate the parallel rim seam so it forms a single clean contour like -a

issues.where: right dark hemisphere and terminator of Mars (crops C, E, I; also pair-01-b.png)
issues.what: the subtle cool blue night-side cloud/haze patches on the dark hemisphere in crops E and I are missing, and rust terrain near the upper-right terminator in crops C and E is slightly brighter and more orange
issues.fix: restore the faint cool blue atmospheric haze patches over the lower-right dark hemisphere and slightly darken/cool the terminator shadow relief to match -a

issues.where: central canyon floor (crop A; also pair-03-b.png center valley)
issues.what: the diagonal band of warm dusty mist across the shadowed canyon floor is slightly brighter and thicker than in -a, slightly lifting valley mid-shadows
issues.fix: reduce the opacity and brightness of the warm valley-floor haze slightly to restore the deeper canyon shadow contrast of -a

issues.where: lower-left shadowed foreground cliff (crop D; also pair-03-b.png lower-left cliff)
issues.what: high-frequency rock grain inside the darkest shadowed cliff strata is slightly softer than in -a
issues.fix: preserve slightly crisper micro-texture in the dark foreground cliff shadows
